verdict.rationale: Trello's marketing claims you can 'Automate tasks and workflows' [trello-docs-3], and the REST API lists Webhooks [trello-docs-21] for event-driven integrations. Nothing in the pack describes how the automations are set up or confirms they run unattended in the background. Missing for 10: documentation of rule/trigger-based automations that run unattended, scheduled or event-triggered automation details, any agentic or AI-driven background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
